description: Istanbul Bicycle Paths Data is a dataset listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Ulaşım Dairesi Başkanlığı. In this data set; It includes data on bicycle paths that are reserved, shared, under construction, on which the transportation traffic commission has been decided, and whose project work is ongoing. Coverage: Ulaşım Dairesi Başkanlığı. The publisher named on the listing is Ulaşım Dairesi Başkanlığı. Its keywords include bisiklet, bisiklet yolu. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GEOJSON. The listing shows 2025-06-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
